nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address holding the privileged owner account used by the onlyOwner modifier.
ZOBABY._balances: mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, mutated in constructor, _transfer and setFeeTotal (mint).
ZOBABY._allowances: nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount consumed in transferFrom and written in _approve.
ZOBABY._tBotAddress: blacklist/bot address controlled by owner via setBlackListBot; gates transfers in _transfer.
ZOBABY._tBlackAddress: blacklisted sender address controlled by owner via setBlackAddress; exempted/short-circuits the max-transfer check.
ZOBABY._tTotal: total token supply, mutable through the owner-only setFeeTotal function.
ZOBABY._maxBlack: owner-settable cap used by the blacklist transfer restriction in _transfer.
ZOBABY._name: token name string returned by name().
ZOBABY._symbol: token symbol string returned by symbol().
ZOBABY._decimals: token decimals returned by decimals().
ZOBABY constructor: assigns the entire _tTotal to _msgSender() and sets _owner in the inherited Ownable constructor.
ZOBABY._transfer: core balance-moving routine; applies the blacklist/max-transfer gate, then SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
ZOBABY.transfer: external ERC20 transfer; forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
ZOBABY.transferFrom: moves tokens for sender via _transfer then decrements the caller allowance using SafeMath.sub.
ZOBABY.approve: sets allowance from _msgSender() to spender through _approve.
ZOBABY._approve: zero-address validation and write of _allowances[owner][spender].
ZOBABY.setFeeTotal: owner-only supply inflation; adds to _tTotal and to the owner balance and emits a Transfer from address(0).
ZOBABY.setMaxTxBlack: owner-only setter rewriting _maxBlack from an unscaled percentage input.
ZOBABY.setBlackListBot: owner-only setter of _tBotAddress.
ZOBABY.setBlackAddress: owner-only setter of _tBlackAddress, the address exempt from the max-transfer gate.
Ownable.owner: view getter that unconditionally returns address(0) instead of the stored _owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: owner-only function that emits OwnershipTransferred but never clears _owner.
Ownable.transferOwnership: owner-only transfer of ownership; validates newOwner and writes _owner.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender() before executing the guarded body.
Context._msgSender: returns msg.sender as address payable.
Address.sendValue: balance-checked low-level call forwarding all gas to an arbitrary payable recipient.
Address._functionCallWithValue: low-level call with value to an arbitrary target, bubbling revert data.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used for balance credits and supply inflation.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used for balance debits and allowance decrease.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication (not used in ZOBABY paths).
SafeMath.div: division-by-zero-checked division.
SafeMath.mod: modulo-by-zero-checked remainder.
ZOBABY.balanceOf: view returning _balances[account].
ZOBABY.totalSupply: view returning the mutable _tTotal.
ZOBABY.allowance: view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
ZOBABY.name: view returning _name.
ZOBABY.symbol: view returning _symbol.
ZOBABY.decimals: view returning _decimals.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers, approvals and minting.
Unbounded owner-only minting in setFeeTotal: increases _tTotal and the owner balance without any cap.
owner() always returns address(0), so integrators reading ownership receive a false zero-owner answer.
renounceOwnership emits the event but does not set _owner to address(0), so ownership is never actually renounced.
Low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient with all gas forwarded, an external interaction point.
Owner-controlled blacklist/transfer gate in _transfer: depends on mutable _tBotAddress/_tBlackAddress and unscaled _maxBlack.
transfer(address recipient): destination of the external transfer.
transfer(uint256 amount): amount forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom(address sender): account whose balance is debited.
transferFrom(address recipient): account credited.
transferFrom(uint256 amount): amount moved and subtracted from the caller allowance.
approve(address spender): address granted the allowance.
approve(uint256 amount): allowance value written.
_approve(address owner): allowance holder.
_approve(address spender): allowance spender.
_approve(uint256 amount): allowance value.
_transfer(address sender): debited account.
_transfer(address recipient): credited account.
_transfer(uint256 amount): amount moved between balances.
setFeeTotal(uint256 amount): amount minted to the owner and added to _tTotal.
setMaxTxBlack(uint256 maxTxBlackPercent): unscaled input multiplied by 10**18 into _maxBlack.
setBlackListBot(address blackListAddress): new bot/gated address.
setBlackAddress(address blackAddress): new exempt/blacklisted sender.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): replacement privileged account.
balanceOf(address account): queried balance holder.
allowance(address owner): allowance holder queried.
allowance(address spender): allowance spender queried.
Ownable constructor local msgSender caching _msgSender() before writing _owner.
sendValue local bool success returned by the low-level call and required to be true.
